name: new-api-desktop
description: New API cross-platform desktop and mobile client built with Tauri

scripts.build:mac: npm run prepare:tauri-assets && tauri build --bundles dmg
scripts.build:linux: npm run prepare:tauri-assets && tauri build --bundles appimage,deb
scripts.android:dev: npm run prepare:tauri-assets && tauri android dev
scripts.android:build:release: node scripts/configure-android.js && npm run prepare:tauri-assets && tauri android build --apk
scripts.build:classic: cd web && bun install --frozen-lockfile && bun run --cwd classic build

author: QuantumNous
